failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to its last-28-day mean while TRANSIT stays at or below -10 for a further two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM remains positive (+4.0) while RETAIL_REC sits near its four-week low (-20.3), showing households are still substituting essential-only trips for discretionary browsing; that substitution keeps RETAIL_REC depressed next week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM positive in all four weeks while RETAIL_REC stays below -18
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises week-on-week while the GROCERY_PHARM minus RETAIL_REC gap stays above 20 points.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES has declined monotonically for four weeks (-10.9 to -12.4), a persistent erosion of the weekday commuting base that removes lunchtime and after-work retail demand; this structural drag keeps RETAIL_REC below its last-28-day mean across the full four-week horizon.

failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its last-28-day mean while WORKPLACES continues to decline week-on-week.
